title: Hearty Charred Croatian Shrimp Skewers
description: A romantic Croatian dish featuring charred shrimp, this recipe combines saeujeot shrimp paste with a sous vide technique for a tender and flavorful result, finished with a dash of friendly spices.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together saeujeot shrimp paste, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Place the skewers in the sous vide machine and cook for 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat.
Remove the skewers from the sous vide machine and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until charred.
Serve the charred shrimp skewers hot, garnished with lemon juice and chopped parsley.
